import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, c, f, rev;
        Edge(int to, int c, int f, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        ArrayList<Edge>[] g;
        int[] d, ptr;
        int n;

        Dinic(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            g = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            d = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
            g[v].add(new Edge(u, cap, 0, 0));
            g[u].add(new Edge(v, 0, 0, 0));
            g[v].get(g[v].size()-1).rev = g[u].size() - 1;
            g[u].get(g[u].size()-1).rev = g[v].size() - 1;
        }

        boolean buildLevel(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(d, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            d[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g[v]) {
                    if (d[e.to] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && e.c > e.f) {
                        d[e.to] = d[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[t] != Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int curFlow) {
            if (v == t) return curFlow;
            for (int i = ptr[v]; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
                Edge e = g[v].get(i);
                int cf = e.c - e.f;
                if (d[e.to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0) {
                    int add = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(curFlow, cf));
                    if (add > 0) {
                        e.f += add;
                        g[e.to].get(e.rev).f -= add;
                        return add;
                    }
                }
                ptr[v]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxflow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (buildLevel(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                int add;
                while ((add = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) != 0) flow += add;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static final int N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static int n, tbad;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] badDist = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] curDist = new int[N][N];
    static int px, py;

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n &&
               a[x][y] != 'Y' && a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsGrid(int sx, int sy, int[][] dist, boolean isBadSource) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] v = q.poll();
            int x = v[0], y = v[1];

            if (!isBadSource && dist[x][y] == badDist[x][y])
                continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && dist[nx][ny] == INF &&
                    dist[x][y] + 1 <= badDist[nx][ny]) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        tbad = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        bfsGrid(px, py, badDist, true);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                badDist[i][j] = Math.min(badDist[i][j], tbad);

        Dinic din = new Dinic(2 * n * n + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0')
                    din.addEdge(0, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                if (b[i][j] != '0')
                    din.addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, 2 * n * n + 1, b[i][j] - '0');
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!ok(i, j)) continue;
                bfsGrid(i, j, curDist, false);
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                        if (ok(i1, j1) && curDist[i1][j1] <= badDist[i1][j1])
                            din.addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
            }

        System.out.println(din.maxflow(0, 2 * n * n + 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
